'''Lynaa''' was a middle-aged [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] fashion designer. She regularly did charity work for wildlife groups and went everywhere with her pet [[Voorpak/Legends|voorpak]], [[Taezii]], which she carried in the pockets of her robes. She attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'', on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Lynaa was gregarious, flamboyant and eccentric and because of this, she tried to act younger than she actually was.
